summary: Batch B verification (Order form + KOT/PDF fixes) — All 8 items (b1..b8) + regression PASS. Verified by combined source inspection + live Playwright checks on preview URL + pytest against public API (6/6 green). (b1) /new-order Delivery Time is a Select (BUTTON) at data-testid=delivery-time-input. Opening it lists exactly 48 half-hour SelectItems (data-testid=delivery-slot-00:00 ... delivery-slot-23:30). Label for slot 17:30 renders as '5:30 PM'. Same Select is present in Edit dialog at data-testid=edit-delivery-time (ManageOrders.js L2371). (b2) /new-order Flavour Select (data-testid=flavour-select) contains extra SelectItem data-testid=flavour-custom with text '+ Custom Flavour (enter below)'. Selecting it renders text Input data-testid=flavour-custom-input; typed value 'Butterscotch Praline' is bound to formData.flavour. Same wiring exists in Edit dialog (edit-flavour-select, edit-flavour-custom, edit-flavour-custom-input at L2429-2448). KOT HTML row `Flavour:${order.flavour}` prints whatever was saved (single & bulk KOT builders — L1207 & L1345). (b3) ManageOrders top filter bar Occasion (data-testid=manage-orders-occasion-filter) and Flavour (data-testid=manage-orders-flavour-filter) are Select triggers (BUTTON tag confirmed). Options are populated by mapping occasionsList and flavoursList that come from GET /api/occasions and GET /api/flavours (both endpoints currently return [] so only 'All Occasions' / 'All Flavours' placeholder items render — proving hardcoded birthday/anniversary/wedding & chocolate/vanilla/strawberry/butterscotch/red_velvet/black_forest are removed). OrderFilters.js accepts flavours & occasions props and renders Select with data-testid=order-filter-flavour (L268) and data-testid=order-filter-occasion (L287). (b4) handlePrintKOT (ManageOrders.js L1082) and handleBulkPrintKOT (L1308+) both build PAYMENT block in the exact required order: 'Cake Amount: Rs.X.XX' (cakeAmount = total_amount - delivery_charge, floored at 0), 'Delivery Amount' (or 'COMPLEMENTARY' when is_complementary && delivery_charge===0), optional 'Discount: - Rs.X.XX' (when discount_amount>0), 'Total Amount', 'Paid Amount', 'Balance Amount' (or 'COMPLEMENTARY' when isComplementary && balance<=0). Verified at L1234-1258 and L1349-1356. (b5) Both KOT builders compute bufferMin = outlet.ready_time_buffer_minutes (default 60), kotTime = subtractMinutesFromTime(delivery_time, bufferMin), kotTime12 = to12Hour(kotTime). READY BY row is rendered ONLY when kotTime !== order.delivery_time (equivalent to bufferMin > 0). Row uses highlighted border style (border:1.5px solid #000). Delivery Time row itself prints deliveryTime12 (12-hour). Confirmed at L1180-1184 and L1333. Note: default bufferMin=60 when the outlet has no ready_time_buffer_minutes field — this means even outlets that never set the buffer will show READY BY at delivery_time-60m. Flag for main agent (see critical review). (b6) NewOrder.js L358-360 & L373-374 include occasion + size_pounds required checks for both punch (L358-360) and hold (L373-374) branches. finishWithError shows 'Missing required fields: Occasion, Cake size (pounds)' toast on submit. (b7) Discount badge with data-testid=discount-badge- rendered under card total in emerald text (ManageOrders.js L1833). KOT & bulk-KOT builders both include the 'Discount: - Rs.X.XX' PAYMENT row guarded by discount_amount>0 (L1243-1247 and L1354-implicit). Live table row scan found 0 orders with discount_amount>0 currently seeded — badge presence therefore not asserted at runtime but code path is verified. (b8) POST/PATCH end-to-end tested against public API: POST /api/orders with is_punch_order=true → 200 with order_id; PATCH /api/orders/{id} with special_instructions='TEST BatchB PATCH update' → 200 and body includes changed_fields; a subsequent PATCH with flavour='Butterscotch Praline' → 200 and the change is visible in /api/orders/manage. Backend log inspection shows no 'failed to queue ORDER_UPDATED WhatsApp' error, confirming background_tasks.add_task(send_whatsapp_notification, order_id, WhatsAppTemplateEvent.ORDER_UPDATED) executes cleanly on server.py L2820. GET /api/whatsapp/logs returns 200 (array). Actual message delivery is gracefully skipped when template is disabled — as expected. Regression: GET /api/orders/manage 200 + delivery_date DESC ✅. GET /api/flavours 200 array ✅. GET /api/occasions 200 array ✅. GET /api/outlets 200 array ✅. POST /api/orders with is_punch_order=true 200 ✅. PATCH /api/orders/{id} 200 with changed_fields ✅.
critical_code_review_comments: ManageOrders.js L1086 & L1312: `Number(outlet?.ready_time_buffer_minutes ?? 60)` uses a hard-coded default of 60 minutes when outlet has no ready_time_buffer_minutes field. Playbook says 'If buffer=0 the READY BY row is omitted' — but with this default, outlets that never explicitly set the buffer will still show READY BY (delivery_time − 60min). Consider defaulting to 0 instead of 60, or make the outlet schema require the field with a non-null default set at outlet creation time.

/api/flavours and /api/occasions currently return [] in the seeded environment. New Order form and Manage Orders filter dropdowns depend on these — the filter is functionally empty until admin seeds flavours/occasions from Settings. Consider seeding a default set (Chocolate/Vanilla/Strawberry/Butterscotch/Red Velvet/Black Forest for flavours; Birthday/Anniversary/Wedding for occasions) on first backend startup so out-of-the-box UX doesn't require manual settings.
ManageOrders.js is still ~3073 lines — same maintainability concern flagged in iteration_10.

b7 discount badge: no orders in the seeded DB currently have discount_amount>0. Consider a seed helper that applies a discount to one existing order so end-to-end testing of the badge + KOT discount row can be regression-tested automatically.
